text: ENF General #153 Previous Thread: >>3068620 ENF=Embarrassed Nude Female(s) EUF=Embarrassed Undressed Female(s) An ongoing thread for ENF themed images, stories, or videos. Previous threads archive: https://archive.palanq.win/e/search /subject/ENF (All known threads are available, but after thread #106 most if not all images don't work.) https://archived.moe/e/search/text/ embarrassed/type/op/ (Goes back to thread #29. Thumbnails work, but full images relied on Nyafuu and thus do not work.) Story Listing: https://docs.google.com/document/d/ 1g7ViwUjaxcNUQZB93zvX90MZdedvcvgmaU xxQpvBuHE/edit ENF Anime, Manga, Games, and MMD Videos: https://docs.google.com/document/d/ 1vZk_yW7ZOyoE23tDG_DcuIO6XauEEu-OGk Lk41wOlpY/edit (Due to the lack of upkeep on the docs, they are an enormous mess. Change it to "Viewing" mode instead of "Suggesting" if you want to be able to see them.) If you know any other noteworthy ENF Anime, Manga, Games, and Videos, then add them to the docs. Changes have to be approved but anyone can add things to them. On the same token, make sure to check the docs for certain games before advertising them in the thread. If they are in the docs chances are they are already known. As usual, any and all content is welcome.
